citations.title: MSCI Announces Leadership Changes Amid Executive Retirement - The Globe and Mail

sentences.quote: On November 12, 2025, MSCI Inc. announced the retirement of C.D. Baer Pettit, who has served in senior leadership roles for over 25 years, including as President and COO. Mr. Pettit will remain as an advisor until the third quarter of 2026 to ensure a smooth transition, with CEO Henry A. Fernandez assuming the role of President from March 1, 2026.
sentences.text: MSCI announced on November 12, 2025 the retirement of C.D. Baer Pettit, president and chief operating officer for over 25 years, with Fernandez assuming the president title on March 1, 2026 and Pettit staying as an adviser into the third quarter of 2026; the board was also cut from twelve to eleven members effective that date.

Internally promoted were Alvise Munari, previously chief product officer, as head of client segments, and Jorge Mina, previously head of analytics, as chief operating officer; Mina also chairs MSCI's AI transformation center of excellence.
